sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: The Ibero-American Architecture Conference, organized by the UIC Barcelona School of Architecture and curated by Professor Fredy Massad, aims to provide a rigorous examination of professional practice, construction, and architectural research in Ibero-America, addressing the diverse social, cultural, economic, and territorial contexts that define the region. The program analyzes how architecture, through various local realities, responds to some of the major challenges of the 21st century.
